تسترعون (form X)
# تَسْتَرْعُونَ (tastarʕūna) /tas.tar.ʕuː.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْعَى (istarʕā)
# تُسْتَرْعَوْنَ (tustarʕawna) /tus.tar.ʕaw.na/: second-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَرْعَى (istarʕā)
